Your holdings: Your leveraged chip ETFs are bleeding heavily: SOXL is down -65.72%, MUU -35.25%, and SMH -17.9%. These "SELL" statuses are critical, especially on margin, as drops are amplified. SPAL is also down -48.11%.

Bottom line: With significant losses in leveraged tech, focus on risk management and protecting capital before considering new aggressive plays.
